== Ingredients ==
* 1 large raw [[Cookbook:bacon|bacon]] hock
* 2 [[Cookbook:egg|eggs]]
* Green [[Cookbook:Food Coloring|food coloring]]
* Blue food coloring

== Procedure ==
# Place the bacon hock in a pot of water. Add green food color, following the manufacturer's guidelines.
# Bring to the [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for 60–90 minutes.
# Remove the hock and let it cool slightly.
# Carefully remove the skin leaving the fat layer intact.
# If the hock is the desired shade of green, place on an platter. If not, return to pot and add color until the right shade is reached. Transfer hock to platter.
# [[Cookbook:Separating Eggs|Separate]] eggs into whites and yolks.
# [[Cookbook:Poaching|Poach]] the egg yolks in water with blue food coloring.
# Poach the egg whites in uncolored water.
# Place the egg whites on platter with hock, and place the yolks on the whites.
# Serve using a tri-pronged fork.
